verdict.rationale: Zero documents an official MCP server whose tools cover listing, searching, sending, deleting, labeling, bulk archiving and marking emails read/unread. It also offers AI features to compose emails and ask questions about mailbox content or specific threads. Together these let a user drive the mailbox with natural language through an AI agent, but setup requires copying a browser session cookie into an Authorization header (OAuth is only 'coming soon'). Missing for 10: evidence of a native in-app natural-language command interface, a streamlined (non-cookie) connection flow, and hands-on or independent corroboration that natural-language operation works end to end.
